settings.risk.label: Risk and your marks
settings.risk.body: How much an appointed role may settle here. At low and medium risk a role you appoint answers what its grants cover, held for your Overrule; at high risk none does, and every decision waits on you. A mark keeps one kind of act yours whatever the risk: this place’s production releases. Only you set this: an agent’s press of it goes on your card in every mode.
settings.risk.says.low: Low risk: a role you appoint settles what its grants cover, held for your Overrule.
settings.risk.says.medium: Medium risk: a role you appoint settles what its grants cover, held for your Overrule.
settings.risk.says.high: High risk: no role settles anything here; every decision waits on you.
settings.risk.saved: The risk and marks of {{name}} are saved.
settings.risk.acts.label: Acts and who answers
settings.risk.acts.body: For each kind of act, whether it needs a yes here and whose: nobody’s (it passes, and is recorded), a role’s (the role’s agent by default) or yours. The narrowest place with a row decides, then Daoris’s seed. Choosing a class changes nothing until you save it, and the waits it would open or release are shown first. Only you change a row; who holds power stays yours whatever you set.
settings.risk.acts.locked: Fixed: only you change who holds power.
settings.risk.acts.week: This week: {{passed}} passed, {{asked}} asked for a yes.
settings.risk.acts.fault: The risk policy does not read ({{problem}}): every act reads as yours until it is mended.
settings.risk.acts.unknown: Rows naming no act this build knows, not read: {{rows}}.
settings.risk.acts.none: {{act}}: this change opens and releases no wait.
